question: How many orders has each customer placed?
sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: What is the total revenue per product category?
sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM categories cat JOIN products p ON p.category_id = cat.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY revenue DESC
description: Multi-table join through products and order_items

question: List the top 5 customers by total payment amount.
sql: SELECT c.id, c.email, SUM(p.amount) AS total_paid FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.email ORDER BY total_paid DESC LIMIT 5

question: How many orders are in each status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
description: Simple GROUP BY on a categorical column

question: Which products have never been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL
description: Anti-join via LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
